name: MOON DS800
description: Four-voice analogue polysynth with five sound sources per voice. Two oscillators, each with a triangle wavefolder and a symmetry control for harmonic edge, plus a ring modulator, a sub oscillator and white, pink or low-frequency noise. A resonant ladder filter with its own contour and key tracking. Every key is independently pressure-sensitive, so leaning into one pad opens that note's filter and leaves the others untouched. Six-slot modulation matrix with any source to any destination, two free-running LFOs, and a stepped sample-and-hold on a 0.2 to 100 Hz clock.
author: Moongriffin
